en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 11 pm as squally storms continue
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory first issued the warning at 7 pm and later extended it, expecting a few more squally thunderstorms over the territory this evening.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 7 pm on Tuesday and subsequently extended its validity until 11 pm, saying a few squally thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong.
Earlier in the evening the warning had been set to expire at 9 pm and referred to localised thunderstorms over the New Territories. The extension broadened the expected area of impact.

The Observatory advised members of the public outdoors to seek safe shelter, to leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or water sports, and not to stand on high ground or near conductive objects, trees or masts while thunderstorms occur.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至晚上11時 預料仍有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台傍晚7時發出雷暴警告，其後將有效時間延長至今晚11時，預料香港仍有幾陣狂風雷暴。
body: 天文台於周二傍晚7時發出雷暴警告，其後將有效時間延長至今晚11時，預料香港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
警告較早前原定於晚上9時屆滿，並指新界有局部地區雷暴；延長後涵蓋範圍擴大。
天文台提醒市民如身處室外請到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動，亦切勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
